_meta.strategy_name: VWAP Mean Reversion + OI Wall Confluence (Hybrid)
_meta.status: proposal / not wired into engine yet
_meta.origin: Refinement of user-proposed VWAP mean reversion spec, retaining existing OI/PCR/VIX edge from signal_engine.py
notes: This file is a spec-only draft. It is NOT loaded by main.py, scalper_main.py or signal_engine.py.
Intended workflow: (1) review & tune thresholds, (2) backtest in /backtesting, (3) wire a second signal path in signal_engine.py.
All percentages are decimal fractions unless suffixed _pct.

trend_gate.reason: VWAP mean reversion fails in strongly trending sessions

time_window.reason: Avoids opening auction noise and expiry-day close distortions

session_range.gap_day_reason: HoD/LoD unreliable in first 45m on gap opens

extension_gap.purpose: How far from VWAP before a reversion setup becomes valid

stop_loss.buffer_reason: 2-point fixed buffer from original spec is too tight on 3m Nifty

position_sizing.note: Corrects original spec formula 'Capital / (Risk / SL)' which gave wrong units.

min_reward_threshold.reason: ATM options have 0.15-0.25% round-trip cost + 0.5% realistic slippage

target_2.action: trail stop to breakeven, ride remainder

momentum_exit.rule: two consecutive 3m candles close against trade direction
momentum_exit.reason: Single-candle exit (original spec) over-fires on normal pullbacks

time_exit.source: matches existing theta shield in main.py

open_questions: Are 0.3% + 2*ATR the right extension thresholds for BankNifty and SENSEX, or should they be instrument-specific?
Should trend_gate use 15m ADX or 5m ADX?
Should we allow this strategy to run ALONGSIDE the OI-wall strategy or only as a fallback when walls are unclear?
Backtest window: 2 years of 3m data available in /backtesting?
